subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: After the compatibility and API-boundary repairs, should role-specific memory ownership become OpenClaw's permanent core configuration and Plugin SDK architecture?
rationale: This PR creates durable public selectors, per-agent inheritance semantics, and external hook contracts; technical correctness cannot decide whether maintainers want to support this taxonomy long term.

options.title: Adopt after repairs
options.body: Accept the architecture after legacy upgrades preserve behavior, the role type is leaf-owned, and exact-head proof passes.

options.title: Settle the RFC first
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers approve the role names, inheritance rules, and hook contract in the linked RFC.

options.title: Retain one memory owner
options.body: Decline the new public surface and keep complementary behavior behind plugin-specific mechanisms.

recommendation.title: Adopt after repairs
recommendation.body: Accept the architecture after legacy upgrades preserve behavior, the role type is leaf-owned, and exact-head proof passes.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the memory-slot surface and led the central memory runtime and plugin-boundary refactors.
